defectsClosed.title: Actor 2 and Job C could not run in the execute job
defectsClosed.detail: job-b-execute has no checkout and invoked npx vite-node against repository-relative TypeScript; the script, vitest.config.ts, package.json and node_modules were all absent. Job C additionally referenced repository-relative ID-map and truth-key files deliberately excluded from the truth-free preparation artifact.
defectsClosed.correction: Job A builds a self-contained host verifier bundle runnable by plain pinned Node, and a separate minimal identity inventory artifact downloaded only for the host-side Job C step

defectsClosed.title: a missing identity inventory became an empty one
defectsClosed.detail: The CLI defaulted an absent ID map or truth-key file to [], so Job C scanned zero markers and could report clean.
defectsClosed.correction: the fallback is deleted; presence, closed schema, frozen digest, exact counts and no duplicate or empty marker are all required

defectsClosed.title: a failed acquisition bypassed Actor 2
defectsClosed.detail: set -euo pipefail ended the job on a nonzero runner status before the Actor 2 step, which had no always() condition. The forensic upload lacked the mandatory raw-verification report.
defectsClosed.correction: the container status is captured into acquisition-status.json without terminating the step; Actor 2 runs with if: always(); Job C, the volume rule and the verified upload are each conditioned on the previous succeeding; adjudication happens last, after preservation

defectsClosed.title: marker and manifest verification were not exact
defectsClosed.detail: verifyRunCommitted iterated whatever fileDigests contained, so a one-entry subset with a correct requiredFiles list read as committed. Actor 2 verified disk against the manifest but not the reverse, so phantom entries passed. Its no-forbidden-evidence-key finding was hardcoded true.
defectsClosed.correction: a closed marker schema with exact ordered digests and a recomputed aggregate; bidirectional manifest verification; and the forbidden-key finding replaced by an explicit delegation record

defectsClosed.title: the uploaded artifact identity was recorded but not carried or compared
defectsClosed.detail: uploaded-artifact.json was written and never uploaded, exposed or compared. GitHub's download-action digest check produces a warning, not a load-bearing failure.
defectsClosed.correction: artifact ID, digest, URL and producing head SHA are job outputs; the follow-up job downloads by exact artifact ID, compares the metadata digest and run association with narrowly scoped actions: read, re-verifies contents, and uploads a verification receipt

rehearsal.name: verifier-transport-rehearsal
proves: Actor 2 runs with plain Node and no checkout
Job C runs with the separate inventory
a planted phantom manifest entry fails
an upload/redownload by artifact ID matches its metadata digest
